about.heroLead: A trusted partner and premier provider of high-quality works across the Middle East and the Gulf.
about.intro: Kased Khair is planning to become a leader — a trusted partner and a premier provider of high-quality works — by delivering every project to the highest standards through hard work, ethical practices, and top-quality performance throughout the Middle East and Gulf area.
about.aboutText: Kased Khair is one of the leading companies providing machinery supply, civil construction, marine works, and industrial services across all sectors. We are involved in most of the region’s biggest and most complex projects and facilities, reflecting our position as a leader in our chosen markets.
about.visionText: Our motto is based on client focus driven by innovation, technology, and people’s development. This enables us to be the company of choice for all stakeholders in the dynamic and demanding sectors we serve. We seek excellence and differentiation in civil and marine construction, maintaining leadership in construction and facilities management.
about.missionText: Kased Khair is a well-known company in Egypt and Saudi Arabia in supplying, infrastructure, civil construction, and marine projects. We are committed to building long-lasting relationships with our clients and community by providing a high standard of construction quality and on-time delivery, while ensuring our integrity, performance, and customer satisfaction.
about.historyP1: Kased Khair for General Supplies and Contracting goes back to the early nineties — exactly 1991 — when Mr. Saeed Gamal started the company in Egypt to provide civil and marine construction services.
about.historyP2: With technical expertise and excellence of construction quality, the company developed into a centre of construction, operation, and maintenance for prestigious and complex projects of advanced technology throughout Egypt.
about.historyP3: Under sound management, a team of dedicated professionals, and a record of quality and reliability, operations expanded to Saudi Arabia and subsequently to other Gulf countries, North Africa, and the Mediterranean.
about.historyP4: After many successful projects at home and abroad, Kased Khair has grown into an ISO-certified multi-divisional organisation with subsidiaries and affiliates in Egypt and the Gulf Area.
about.assetsText: Kased Khair’s staff of experts and professionals provide and execute the best solutions for every project. Under the leadership of CEO Mr. Saeed Gamal and our managers, exceptionally qualified engineers and highly trained technicians — together with employees in all related fields — make Kased Khair an award-winning company, executing every project efficiently to international standards.

projectsPage.heroLead: A story of success and achievement across marine, civil, and industrial works.
projectsPage.intro: Founded by Mr. Saeed Gamal to provide civil and marine construction services, Kased Khair grew over the years into a multinational organisation. Over three decades of passionate work, we cultivated a reputation as the contractor for general supplies, industrial projects, integrated projects, marine projects, dredging, roads, steel structures, and specialised electromechanical works.
projectsPage.emptyRoads: Road projects are part of our capability set. Featured work currently lives under buildings, marine, and steel.

awards.heroLead: First-class credentials, ISO systems, and certificates of appreciation from Egypt’s leading authorities.
awards.membershipsText: Egyptian Federation for Construction and Building Contractors — first-class company in marine projects, integrated buildings projects, and electromechanical projects.
awards.awardsText: We are privileged and greatly honoured to receive these certificates of appreciation for our work on these projects.
awards.isoText: In a quality-driven world, we pride ourselves on being among the first companies in our market certified to rigorous ISO standards. Together they form a stringent system achieved only by an organisation of our capability, knowledge, commitment, and expertise.
awards.completionText: We are proud to gain our clients’ confidence and surpass their expectations with every project — executed with accuracy, proficiency, and perfection.

equipment.heroLead: Marine plant, heavy civil machinery, and specialist steel capability behind every landmark we deliver.
equipment.intro: Kased Khair executes marine and civil works at national scale. Our plant and fleet support quays, dredging, shore protection, integrated buildings, and large-span steel structures — so programme, quality, and safety stay under our own control.

marine.title: Marine fleet
marine.text: Plant for quay construction, jetties, breakwaters, and dredging — including marine equipment used on shore-protection and naval-base assignments.

civil.title: Heavy civil plant
civil.text: Machinery for diaphragm walls, CFA piles, compound steel-pipe and sheet-pile berths, and large-scale building complexes.

dredging.title: Dredging capability
dredging.text: Proven delivery on major dredging programmes, including channel clearance of tens of millions of cubic metres.

steel.title: Steel fabrication
steel.text: Large-span hangars and covered halls — including structures exceeding 8,000 m² with spans up to 110 metres.
